subject: general
question: The radius of a metallic spherical ball is 8 cm. If the metallic ball is melted and recasted into N number of hemisphere of radius equal to the half the radius of sphere, then find the value of N.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The number of small objects **N** = (Volume of large object) ÷ (Volume of small object).

N = ((4/3) × π × R³) ÷ ((2/3) × π × r³) = 2 × (R/r)³.

Given **radius** of hemisphere **r = R/2**, so the ratio **R/r = 2**.

N = 2 × (2)³ = 2 × 8 = 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of **metallic spherical ball** (R) = 8 cm

Radius of **hemisphere** (r) = R/2 = 8/2 = 4 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of **Sphere** = (4/3) × π × R³

Volume of **Hemisphere** = (2/3) × π × r³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fa831d023f6e4e7a468205aa3903c658bfa6f41fc0f8794ec0263b3b3bfee35.png] 

**Calculations:**

According to the **conservation of volume** principle, the total volume remains the same after melting.

⇒ Volume of Sphere = N × Volume of Hemisphere

⇒ (4/3) × π × (8)³ = N × (2/3) × π × (4)³

⇒ (4/3) × 512 = N × (2/3) × 64

⇒ 2 × 512 = N × 64

⇒ 1024 = 64N

⇒ N = 1024 / 64

⇒ N = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area (TSA) of a sphere is given by the formula 4πR².

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere

A solid hemisphere has a curved surface area of 2πr² and a flat base area of πr², making the TSA = 3πr².

Volume Invariance

In melting and recasting problems, the **total volume** of the material remains constant unless a loss percentage is mentioned.</p
